lines.t: Oh, oh, oh
Heart on the altar, knees on the ground
Whispered desire, laying it down
Knowing you see what I can't see now
I'm holding my breath and I breathe you out
Not my will, but yours be done
I lay it all down, every crown, every run
If the cup don't pass, I won't turn and run
Cause I'm already held in the arms of the sun
Cause I'm already held in the arms of the sun
Yeah, I came with a list full of ones full of plans
Tried to write my own script with these shaky hands
But you erode my lines with a bleeding love
Turned a selfish wish list to a servant's trust
I used to chase my comfort, try to dodge the pain
Now I see that real peace walks through the rain
If you opened up the heavens just to call my name
How could any of my dreams ever stay the same?
Every fear, every tear here in the night
I lift up, let it fall in your light
Even if I never get what I pray
I still got you and that's enough for always
Not my way
But if your feet done
I lay it all down, every crown, every run
The cup don't pass, I won't turn and run
Cause I'm already held in the arms of the sun
I'm already held in the arms of the sun
I've been wrestling desire, trying to make it fit
Telling heaven all the ways I think my life should hit
But you're not a backup for my broken plan
You're the fire in my bones, you're the great I am
So I bring every why, every when, every how
Drop them all at your feet, I surrender now
If this road runs straight through the valley floor
You be with me in the shadows like you were before
If it breaks me, let it break me into love

The cup don't pass, I won't turn and run
Cause I'm already held in the arms of the sun

So I'll sing this line till the day I'm home
Not my will, but yours alone
